title: Genesis Visual Art Direction & Character Reference Sheet
artStyle: Full-colour Digital Manhwa & Webtoon Graphic Novel
palettePhilosophy: Atmospheric, rich, warm cinematic lighting rooted in ancient Near Eastern landscapes, transitioning from primordial cosmic indigo/gold to lush fertile greens, terracotta desert sands, and regal Egyptian lapis and gold.

characters.name: Adam & Eve
characters.visualFeatures: Formed in divine dignity. In Eden: luminous natural grace, serene expressions, no artificial clothing. Post-Fall: rough, durable garments of skin, sorrowful yet persevering countenances.

characters.name: Noah
characters.visualFeatures: Sturdy, patient patriarch with weathered sun-bronzed skin, silver-streaked dark beard, cedar-dusted working apron and wool tunic. Calm, steadfast eyes holding hope against gathering tempests.

characters.name: Abraham (Abram)
characters.visualFeatures: Dignified, commanding yet gentle elder. Flowing mantle of desert-spun linen with indigo trim, silver beard, walking staff of aged olive wood, eyes accustomed to gazing into the starry heavens.

characters.name: Sarah (Sarai)
characters.visualFeatures: Regal beauty and enduring grace; woven amber headveil framing warm, expressive eyes. In youth: radiant noble bearing; in elder years: laughter and deep warmth holding infant Isaac.

characters.name: Hagar & Ishmael
characters.visualFeatures: Hagar: Egyptian linen wrap, dark braided hair, resilient eyes of survival. Ishmael: wild and free desert youth with bow and quiver at his side.

characters.name: Isaac
characters.visualFeatures: Contemplative, peaceful countenance; deep-thinking gaze. Earth-toned shepherd robes of ochre and unbleached wool. In elder years, blind yet reverent with trembling hands.

characters.name: Rebekah
characters.visualFeatures: Energetic, courageous, and decisive. Crimson-embroidered headscarf, terracotta water amphora on shoulder, silver nose ring and bracelets from Abraham's servant.

characters.name: Esau (Edom)
characters.role: The Hunter of the Open Field
characters.visualFeatures: Broad-shouldered, robust, and athletic. Thick auburn/red hair and beard, hairy arms, rugged hunting leathers, bow and quiver, intensely emotional temperament.

characters.name: Jacob (Israel)
characters.role: The Wrestler with God & Father of the 12 Tribes
characters.visualFeatures: Sharp, intense amber eyes, dark hair; quiet shepherd's tunic in youth. After Peniel: distinguished by a limp and an aura of spiritual gravity, leaning on his staff.

characters.name: Rachel & Leah
characters.role: Mothers of the Tribes of Israel
characters.visualFeatures: Leah: soft, gentle eyes, patient demeanour, draped in woven blue-indigo shawls. Rachel: vibrant beauty, graceful shepherdess of her father's sheep, draped in rose-coral wraps.

characters.name: Joseph
characters.visualFeatures: Youth: bright-eyed dreamer wearing an ankle-length tunic with ornate woven sleeves of multi-coloured silks (crimson, gold, lapis, emerald). Egypt: clean-shaven in royal Egyptian style, heavy gold Wesekh collar, royal signet ring, fine white royal linen shendyt, eyes holding deep compassion and hidden tears.

characters.name: Judah
characters.role: The Leader & Lion of the Brethren
characters.visualFeatures: Fierce, commanding presence with strong jaw and determined stride. Carries a signet ring, cord, and carved oak staff. Undergoes profound transformation from callous seller of Joseph to selfless intercessor willing to become a slave for Benjamin.

characters.name: Benjamin
characters.visualFeatures: Youthful, gentle features resembling his late mother Rachel. Modest wool tunic, cherished closely by elderly father Jacob and protected fiercely by his older brothers in Egypt.

environments.name: Garden of Eden
environments.palette: Emerald green, crystal turquoise, luminous gold, blooming magenta
environments.features: Tree of Life with golden fruit, four branching crystal rivers, lush non-decaying flora

environments.name: The High Seas of the Deluge
environments.palette: Deep sapphire, slate charcoal, midnight indigo, electric lightning white
environments.features: Massive three-deck pitch-coated cypress Ark cresting giant swells

environments.name: Ur of the Chaldees & Haran
environments.palette: Mudbrick terracotta, baked brick, river reeds, ancient Mesopotamian ziggurats

environments.name: The Hills of Canaan (Bethel, Hebron, Shechem)
environments.palette: Olive grove greens, limestone white, terraced vineyards, rocky crags, open skies

environments.name: Imperial Egypt & The Nile Valley
environments.palette: Limestone white, gold leaf, lapis lazuli, turquoise, papyrus reed green, Nile blue
environments.features: Colonnaded palaces, hieroglyphic frescoes, massive grain storehouses, fertile black-soil delta of Goshen
